subject: Gartner reference intake: Magnolia Health — scheduling, SOC2 artifacts, NDA
messages:
From: Priya Menon <pm@gartner.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir.g@maghealth.com>
Cc: Gartner Research Admin <research@gartner.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 16:15:00 -0400
Subject: Gartner reference request — Magnolia Health (case + evidence)

Hi Karthik and Samir,

Hope youre both well. Were running a short client reference and supporting-evidence intake for an upcoming quadrant vignette and would love to include Magnolia Health as a customer voice. High-level ask: a 45-minute reference interview (recorded) + a compact set of audit artifacts that verify production controls.

Proposed agenda (45 min):
- 5m intros
- 15m product & integration overview (customer)
- 15m outcomes / metrics + cost/latency impact
- 10m security/compliance Qs

Ideal windows next week (US ET): Tue 10:00-12:00, Wed 14:00-17:00.

For artifacts, the research team typically requests: SOC2 report summary, data residency statement, and any sanitized case notes we can include. We do not share artifacts externally without explicit permission — any materials you provide will be redacted per your guidance.

If Magnolia is open, can you confirm:
1) best POC for the call (name/email)
2) availability windows
3) whether youre comfortable sharing a SOC2 summary and a short redacted customer case note?

Thanks,
Priya Menon
Sr. Research Analyst, Gartner
pm@gartner.com

----
Note: This is a research intake; any confidentiality concerns, flag them and we can route to legal.

From: Samir Gupta <samir.g@maghealth.com>
To: Priya Menon <pm@gartner.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 1 Jul 2028 18:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Gartner reference request — Magnolia Health (case + evidence)

Thanks, Priya. Magnolia is happy to participate. I can be the customer POC for the interview.

Availability next week: Tue 10:30-11:30 ET or Wed 15:00-16:00 ET (prefer Tue).

We can share a SOC2 summary (non-PII) and a redacted case note. Ill coordinate with our security team on redaction.

Samir
Director, Cloud Engineering
Magnolia Health
samir.g@maghealth.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Priya Menon <pm@gartner.com>, Samir Gupta <samir.g@maghealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jul 2028 09:18:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Gartner reference request — Magnolia Health (case + evidence)

Hi Priya / Samir,

Thanks for the fast reply and Samir, thanks for being the POC. Ill run point on Redwood side. Attaching a SOC2 summary and an anonymized case note for review. (Attachments: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf, redacted_customer_case_notes.docx)

A couple of coordination notes:
- We prefer Tue 10:30 ET and will block a 45-minute slot once Priya confirms.
- For artifacts: Marissa (ccd) will handle the NDA/redline and provide guidance about what Magnolia should expect us to redact. We will only share the SOC2 summary (top-line) and the redacted case note; no raw logs or PHI.
- For the call: please let us know if Gartner needs a technical sandbox demo. We can keep it high level but bring an engineer (Olga) for architecture questions.

Agenda (final proposed)
1) 5m intros
2) 12-15m Magnolia: integration with Redwood and production footprint
3) 15m outcomes: cost/latency impact, SLOs, ROI metrics (Samir to present)
4) 10m compliance/security: SOC2 overview + data residency

If that looks good Ill send a calendar invite and an updated HubSpot note (deal id attached).

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf, redacted_customer_case_notes.docx

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir.g@maghealth.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.com>, Priya Menon <pm@gartner.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 11:02:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Gartner reference request — Magnolia Health (case + evidence)

Hi all,

Quick legal note and attached redline: redline_NDA_20280702.pdf. Two items to call out for Magnolia and Samir:
- We will not share any PHI or raw customer logs. Any operational examples must be sufficiently aggregated and anonymized.
- SOC2 summary is fine to share; do not attach the full SOC2 report without an executed NDA and DPA addendum that lists the research distribution explicitly.
- If Gartner requests more granular telemetry, please send that request to legal@redwood.com and well evaluate on a case-by-case basis.

Samir: if youd like, we can produce a version of the case note with customer-facing metrics only (no trace ids or timestamps). Please confirm acceptable redaction level and well return final files within 24 hours of confirmation.

Marissa Cole
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

Attachments: redline_NDA_20280702.pdf

From: Priya Menon <pm@gartner.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Samir Gupta <samir.g@maghealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jul 2028 13:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Gartner reference request — Magnolia Health (case + evidence)

Thanks, Marissa and team. Thats helpful. We can do Tue 10:30-11:15 ET. Confirming: we only need the SOC2 summary and the redacted case note prior to the call; no raw logs. If possible, please upload materials to a secure research folder (we can accept DocuSign or a secure link) and include any short bullet points Samir would like to highlight during the interview.

Also, we have two quick follow-ups for the interview prep:
- Short written Q&A on data residency: one paragraph explaining where customer data is stored for Magnolia (EU/US/other) and retention policy.
- A contact for technical follow-up (Olga is fine).

Ill send a calendar invite to the confirmed slot and route a simple consent form prior to recording.

Best,
Priya
